summary: Bound Bitcoin container swap and add an explicit 64 GiB initial-sync profile
details: Each Bitcoin resource profile now freezes memory, combined memory-plus-swap, and dbcache as one validated tuple instead of allowing Docker's implicit memory-sized swap allocation.

The 64 GiB steady-state profile uses 24 GiB memory with a 26 GiB combined ceiling, while the explicit-only ibd-64g profile uses 32 GiB memory, a 34 GiB combined ceiling, and 20 GiB dbcache for controlled initial-sync acceleration.
Automatic profile selection never chooses ibd-64g; operators must return to performance-64g after IBD and txindex complete.
operator_actions: When upgrading an existing node, install the new node kit, run usdb-node down, reapply balanced-32g or performance-64g with usdb-node set-bitcoin-profile, activate the release, run doctor, and then restart with usdb-node up.
Use ibd-64g only on a host with at least 56 GiB visible memory during controlled Bitcoin initial sync, then stop the node and switch back to performance-64g before normal steady-state operation.
